notes.title: Just a minor update for the Top Down Shooter
notes.content: Added more ammunitions bonus for the level 3, Top Down Shooter.

notes.title: The last BIG BIG update!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,
Here is a big big update!
- Created a whole new level to replace the old Top down shooter level.
- Removed the first level as it wasn't so good ^^
- Updated UI and game difficulty.
- Added more Spanish translation.

Hope you'll like it, do not hesitate to write a feedback, thank you!

notes.title: About this update
notes.content: Added Spanish language for the game interface and a warning to let players know about some important gameplay options.

notes.title: About this update
notes.content: Fixed a bug with the "Healthbar" mode, for the Captain's spaceship.

notes.title: About this important update
notes.content:
I added an option in the menu Gameplay to choose between the default mode for Captain spaceship's health system
(Die on one impact) or to have an health bar and don't die on one impact.
Now you can reach most easily the checkpoints!
I listened to the player's feedbacks and I tried to make a better version of my game.
This is the last big update, I'll soon work on the second game.

Thank you for your support!

notes.title: About this update
notes.content:
Updated the tutorial, to give more information on the gameplay.
The game is now in a more accessible version, I listened to the reviews of the players.
Good game and thank you for your support!

notes.title: What’s news for this last big update?
notes.content:
- The number of lives is 7 instead of 5.
- The popup windows of the Captain when he touches the decorations are removed.
- Level 2 difficulty adjustment.
- If you are game over after Boss 1, you will start again at the level where you were.
- A Twin stick control mode can be activated in the Gameplay menu and for the Top Down shooter.

notes.title: I'd like to know your opinion about the game
notes.content:
Hello everyone,
I got some feedbacks here, for some I don't understand some comments about the tutorial, popup messages...
First Jash isn't a clone of R-Type, R-type was made by a japanese studio with one million dollars budget.
So I just tried to make my own style, with some original ideas and fun, and everything happens for a reason:
For example the Captain didn't fight for a while, so he'll not be very good for the Top down shooter levels.
Also some people prefer twin stick control, some not so I can't satisfy everyone.
And Jash is the first game of a trilogy, the story will continue but the style of game will change.
I worked one year and half on it, so thx for your support and for the "power" you give me!

So feel free to tell me what you liked, didn't like, we can share and exchange here.

notes.title: About this big update
notes.content:
Hello everyone !
[b]One big announcement for 2 important news :[/b]
-	For now and during 11 days, the game is discounted 50% and it will be just one time.
-	I updated the game and now there are Steam achievements, the Bonus Level is playable (before you needed to finish the game) and I adjusted the Level 1 difficulty.
[b]I strongly recommend to finish the Level 1,[/b] this one is just an introduction and from Level 2, it’s more original!
I think it will be the last big update, as I worked alone and for more than one year to finish the first game of a trilogy.
I tried to offer fun anf different gameplays, original and fun ideas for this first game.
So do not hesitate to write a review HERE if you like it, it can really help me or I’m aware of advices (I have a website, contact form, email or Discord ([url=https://discord.gg/Rj5uckhVUs]https://discord.gg/Rj5uckhVUs[/url]).
My second game will follow the story but will be less « chill » and will not be a shoot’em up.
I’ll try to post some videos in English on my Youtube channel, about video games industry (for those interested).
Thank you for your support and enjoy!

notes.title: Jash is available!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

After more than one year to work hard on Jash, it's finally available today! ːsteamhappyː

[list]
[*] Jash is the first game of an incoming trilogy (with different kind of games).
[*] It's an unconventional game and not only shmup.
[*] I plan to publish a free update if I can sell enough, to add one "pure" shoot'em up mode
[/list]

Thank you for your patience and your support,  I'll publish soon a video on Youtube,
to explain more about the creation and the game.

Do not hesitate to contact me, share about it and I hope you'll like and enjoy it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41648285/d8ea3e308a9b63936bcf7d242877d48ee3243da3.png[/img]

Bonjour à tous,

Après plus d'un an à travailler dur sur Jash, il est enfin disponible aujourd'hui ! ːsteamhappyː

[list]
Jash est le premier jeu d'une trilogie à venir (avec différents styles/types de jeux).
[*] C'est un jeu non conventionnel et pas seulement un shmup.
[*] Je prévois de publier une mise à jour gratuite si j'arrive à en vendre assez, pour ajouter un mode shoot'em up "pur".

Merci pour votre patience et votre soutien, je publierai prochainement une vidéo sur Youtube,
pour en savoir plus sur la création et le jeu.

N'hésitez pas à me contacter, partager à ce sujet et j'espère que vous l'aimerez et l'apprécierez !
